feeds.title: HiP Paris
feeds.description: Visiting Paris for the first time? Been here before and want to explore a new part of town? HiP Paris Blog will point you in the right direction and introduce you to off-the-beaten-path places, hip and happening people and events, and experiences you might otherwise overlook.

feeds.title: My Parisian Life
feeds.description: This website can help you find a romantic restaurant, activities with your kids, plan your next visit, discover places and treasures or share practical information on life in Paris.

feeds.title: Le blog de Lili
feeds.description: The Lifestyle Blog of a Parisian: brunches, restaurants, travels, exhibitions, tips, cultural outings in Paris and around the world since 2008.

feeds.title: GLOSE
feeds.description: Glose is a lifestyle blog, a blog of trends, ideas for outings to Paris, moments of life, and mood tickets.

feeds.title: Lodgis Blog
feeds.description: Newcomer, expatriate, student, or just in love with Paris? Find tips and tricks that the Lodgis team prepares for you every week to make the most of your new Parisian life!

feeds.title: Everyday Parisian
feeds.description: Everyday Parisian was founded in 2016 as a result of this desire to meld the French lifestyle with American surroundings and to create a community with a shared love for Paris. It aims to highlight the fun and new ways to 'Frenchify' daily life, offers travel recommendations, shares fashion inspiration, and much more.

feeds.title: Paris, Maman & Moi
feeds.description: I share my favorites and chronicles my life in Paris since 2007.

feeds.title: The New Paris Dispatch
feeds.description: Paris news, stories, events, insights, and more by journalist and two-time author Lindsey Tramuta

feeds.title: Carin Olsson
feeds.description: 'Paris in Four Months' (the previous name of this website) started out as a place where I was able to share my experiences on this new adventure but has now turned into so much more. This website is my baby, a creative outlet and a place where I'm happy to share my passion for photography and all the beautiful things and places I come across along my way. I hope you'll enjoy it as much as I enjoy sharing these moments with you.

feeds.title: Hello it's Valentine
feeds.description: Parisian lifestyle, travel and fashion site where the exhilaration reigns through colorful photos. Get sucked in the original universe of Hello it's Valentine and travel through her photographs of Paris and elsewhere.

feeds.title: LaRevueDeKenza By Kenza Sadoun
feeds.description: LaRevueDeKenza Blog provides mood notes, tips, musical favorites, outfits, photography and traveling authored by Fashion, Beauty & Lifestyle Blogger Kenza Sadoun since 2008 based in Paris.

feeds.title: Lost In Cheeseland
feeds.description: Musings on food, love, life, and struggles in Paris from a Philadelphia native.

feeds.title: Paris Pages Blog
feeds.description: Paris Pages Blog is a lifestyle blog telling the hectic Parisian life of our family.

feeds.title: Elles en parlent
feeds.description: The Beauty And Lifestyle Blog authored by Coralie L in Paris.

feeds.title: ALICIA MECHANI
feeds.description: Alicia and Lawrence share their looks, love for travel and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Blondie Baby
feeds.description: A Fashion And Lifestyle Blog in Paris authored by Pauline Gandolfini.

feeds.title: La Vie Locale Blog
feeds.description: A Local guide to discovering the everyday Paris, things to do, and people that make up this beautiful city.

feeds.title: Parlez-Vous Parisien?
feeds.description: Parlez-Vous Parisien is a blog written by an ex-Londoner currently living in Paris. Read it for top tips when visiting the City of Light!

feeds.title: The New New Girl
feeds.description: The new girl is a lifestyle blog created by 22-year-old Parisian Sybille Green. This blog is all about love, passion, colors, flowers, cinema, music, photography, art, fashion and all the things that make life better!

feeds.title: Roses in Paris
feeds.description: The world through the eyes of a Bulgarian woman based in Paris, working and blogging to share the best experiences in life. Fashion, Travel, cooking.

feeds.title: Daphné Moreau
feeds.description: Fashion and The City, a fashion blog (looks), beauty and lifestyle (recipes, cooking, good deals and good addresses) in Paris held by Daphne Moreau since 2007.

feeds.title: La Coquette Italienne
feeds.description: Maria Rosaria Rizzo is an Italian model and TV presenter with an unbridled passion for fashion since childhood and with a creative mind.In 2013 she moved to Paris and she launched the fashion blog 'La Coquette Italienne' which reinterprets the good taste in a chic and feminine Italian style with French contaminations. Life for her is : 'looking for the good in everything'.

feeds.title: The Paris Blog
feeds.description: A guide to Paris France by insider expatriates who live in Paris, France. Save money, find top restaurants and shops.
